Title: Azure Cosmos DB transactional batch support for Java SDK 4.7.0 and above is now available

Body.Content: Transactional batch support enables ACID-compliant transactions for operations on the same logical partition key. Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK v4.7.0 and above now brings preview transactional batch support to Java, a capability already supported by the Azure Cosmos DB .NET SDK. With version 4.7.0, the functionality is exposed by the SDK as an API call. With transactional batch, your Java application may issue a series of requests and require that all of them succeed or fail as a group.  Read the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK v4 Release Notes and see transactional batch sample code for sync and async programming to learn more.
